What happens when you change something on a Setup page

Every picture is the real platform, photographed, with the new parts drawn into the live page. Parts marked To check are new in this round. The rest you have already agreed.

The rules

A change takes effect when you make it
No Save button on Setup pages. What you type, tick or switch applies straight away, as it does today. Pages that open with their own Edit keep it.
A floating box asks first, with the impact
Before any change to who can see or do what, whether it gives more or takes away. And before removing or switching off anything that holds data. It names who or what is affected and how many, with two buttons.
Colours wait for Apply
Apply, Discard, and Undo for about ten seconds after. Leaving with a colour picked but not applied asks first.
Setup pages lose the paragraphs they don't need
As each page is touched. A sentence with a fact in it moves to a hover or into the box that asks; one that only explains goes.

1 · Giving more: the box asks first To check

Roles & access. You press the pen on Custodian's own plan. Nothing changes yet. A box floats beside the cell: who it is, how many people, and what they will be able to do. Change it or Keep as it was.

2 · Taking away: the same box To check

You press the eye on Owner's own reporting, which would take their pen away. The same box says what they lose and how many people hold the role.

3 · After Change it To check

The box closes, the cell takes its new state, and Saved shows beside it for a moment.

4 · Client set-up: no Save, and the box only when something with data would go To check

The shape screen, business units. Names and ticks apply as you change them. Unticking End in Mind here would hide a line Mobile has written, so the box asks first and says so. Unticking something nobody has written in happens straight away.

Supporting functionsNo: a function has no Winning AspirationNot shown
CapabilitiesNo: their first section is only what it is and its North StarNot shown

It sits inside the Winning Aspiration, so it is greyed and off wherever the aspiration is unticked. It starts ticked because it only shows once somebody writes it, so it never adds a Missing and no client's screen moves. Ticked, it shows on the Strategy page under the Winning Aspiration, on the temple picture and on the "What we are aiming at" slide.

7 · Colours Agreed

Pick, and only the colour box changes. Apply, and the page takes it, with Undo for a few seconds. The same for the bands' colours.
